# Barangay Payatas — Digital Portal
> Online platform for barangay services, document requests, and community engagement.

## Key details
- **Type**: Barangay civic management portal (prototype)
- **Location**: Barangay Payatas, Quezon City, Philippines
- **Cost**: Services are priced per document — no bundled plans. Barangay Clearance ₱50, Certificate ₱30, Certificate of Indigency free. Full price list on /services.
- **Refund policy**: All fees are non-refundable once document processing begins. Contact the office for questions.
- **Support**: Hotline +63 2 8123 4567 (24/7 emergencies), email payatas.ledger@qc.gov.ph (1 business day response), office hours Mon-Fri 8AM-5PM.

## Features
- Online document requests (clearance, certificates, business permits)
- Resident registry lookup
- Community announcements and polls
- Anonymous suggestions / citizen's voice
- Volunteer sign-ups
- Issue reporting (blotter, concerns)
- Emergency hotline 911

## Quick links
